verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Sumsub processes applicant documents via API and supports document/data extraction generally (14,000+ document types, RESTful API access to applicant data), implying structured field data is available, but no evidence pack item explicitly documents the API response schema listing specific extracted fields like name, DOB, document number, address, expiry. Missing for 10: explicit API reference/schema showing structured field-level output, example response payloads with named fields, confirmation these are retrievable independent of pass/fail verdicts.
